policy: T0 resolves every historical test into a behavior contract, a current-run target verifier, or an explicitly isolated history-only entry.

entries.reason: The exact project-name set blocked source-port projects.
entries.replacement: Manifest-driven layer direction, forbidden-edge, cycle, and transition-package validation.

entries.reason: It protected the superseded Avalonia.Desktop package-host decision.
entries.replacement: Source-port project classification with an explicit A1-expiring comparison-host package allowance.

entries.reason: Committed verified text is pre-runtime-v2 evidence.
entries.replacement: Fresh gpu-target and dpi-input-target reports verify shell lifecycle gates and measurements.

entries.reason: Hardware/software equality currently proves the shared CPU upload path.
entries.replacement: Current-run backend identity, active GPU context, fallback, visual tolerance, ACK, timing, copy, and wait counters.

entries.reason: Event presence alone does not prove wheel direction, fractional input, hit testing, or cadence.
entries.replacement: Current-run DPI marker, wheel direction, fractional delta, duplicate delivery, hit-test, caret, and frame cadence measurements.

entries.reason: Package and consumer boundaries remain useful but historical execution cannot promote runtime-v2 quality.
entries.replacement: Static consumer isolation stays in shell-source-audit; fresh Windows, Linux, and macOS results are required by cross-platform.

entries.reason: Historical generated-product runs do not establish runtime-v2 visual or input quality.
entries.replacement: API and behavior coverage stays static; H6 product UI target quality requires a fresh dpi-input-target report.

entries.reason: DisplayList command acceptance remains a valid behavior boundary.
entries.replacement: Retained as a unit behavior test without target claims.

entries.reason: ACK and target identifiers remain useful but a fixture is not renderer or shell evidence.
entries.replacement: Fixture validates ACK vocabulary only; current target completion is delegated to gpu-target.

entries.reason: Mailbox, generation, resource, and terminal ACK invariants are backend-neutral.
entries.replacement: Retained in runtime and never used as GPU, DPI, or visual completion evidence.

entries.reason: Their committed reports use pre-runtime-v2 milestone schemas.
entries.replacement: The three target suites consume a fresh versioned runtime-v2 report and emit not-verified when evidence is absent or stale.

entries.reason: One presented frame is useful for startup only and is not a quality gate.
entries.replacement: DorotiDemoApp --runtime-v2 supplies diagnostic artifacts; promotion requires the matching fresh target report thresholds.
